purpose: Close the largest externally observed native-projection gap using only information genuinely knowable before Week 1 of the target season.

external_benchmark_anchor.headline: FFToday won 43 of 54 verified position-stat-season groups on the common cohort.

diagnosis.primary_hypothesis: The current native V1 relies mainly on prior-season player production and cannot adequately represent target-season role changes that a preseason projection service can observe.
examples_of_allowed_preseason_context: target-season team assignment verified before Week 1
known preseason injury/availability status when historically timestamped
explicitly_forbidden: post-Week-1 transactions used as preseason inputs

test_order: Only revisit TE if additional seasons contradict the current native advantage
retention_rule: Retain a feature family only if rolling temporal holdouts and the historical external benchmark show material, reasonably stable improvement. Do not add complexity merely because the feature is intuitively relevant.
commercial_use_rule: Prefer public or commercially usable source data. Dataset-specific licensing and timestamp provenance must be recorded separately from predictive performance.
